readout.method: phone macro or USB microscope photo, one animal per image, scored blind by dish code

viability_check: day 3: count live fragments per dish; dead ones scored 'dead'
status: DRAFT: confirm species and supplier before sealing
species: SET ON ARRIVAL (expected Girardia dorotocephala; record supplier and listing name)
purpose: Rig validation (wetlab/PROTOCOL.md gate rig_validation): water only, 60 trunk fragments in two cutting sessions.
pass_rule: desk_threshold_rule_v1 item 7: wetlab/tabulate.py exits 0 (no control arm over 10% non-normal) and no arm flagged toxic (lethality limit 0.10).

handling.medium: one brand of commercial natural spring water throughout (all published octanol protocols in wetlab/published_handling.csv used spring water)
handling.cut: remove head and tail on a cold damp surface; keep the pharynx-containing trunk piece
handling.water_change: every 2-3 days, and the day after cutting
handling.scoring_day: 14 (published D. japonica scoring day; record day 10 too)

note: Generate dish codes with wetlab/randomize.py only after sealing. Predictions for both arms are sealed by a fresh Predictor before cutting (wetlab/batch_setups.py makes its input).
